skill.name: ai-engineer
skill.description: Design and implement production LLM applications, RAG pipelines, intelligent agents, multimodal workflows, and AI safety controls.
skill.summary: Plan and build production LLM, RAG, agent, and AI integration systems.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All four static findings appear to be false positives after context review. The flagged text describes defensive privacy practices, retrieval techniques, and AI safety controls, with no evidence of prompt injection or malicious intent.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid sending sensitive data to external models without approval.
- Hybrid search combining vector similarity and keyword matching (BM25)
- "Build a production RAG system for enterprise knowledge base with hybrid search"
- Safety prompting: jailbreak detection, content filtering, bias mitigation

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 33 tells users to avoid sending sensitive data to external models without approval. This is a defensive privacy instruction, not system reconnaissance.
Line 58 describes hybrid information retrieval with vector similarity and BM25 keyword matching. It does not request host, network, credential, or environment discovery.
Line 178 is an example prompt for building an enterprise RAG system with hybrid search. It is application search guidance, not reconnaissance against a user system.
Line 91 mentions jailbreak detection as part of safety prompting. The context is defensive content filtering and bias mitigation, not an instruction to bypass safeguards.

content.value_statement: Production AI features need reliable architecture, retrieval quality, safety, and cost controls. This skill guides LLM apps, RAG systems, agents, and integrations from design through rollout.
actual_capabilities: Guides model selection, routing, caching, and cost controls for LLM applications.
Designs RAG pipelines with chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation.
Plans agent workflows with tools, memory, permissions, monitoring, and fallback behavior.
Recommends multimodal AI patterns for document, image, audio, and video workflows.
Adds safety controls for prompt injection, PII handling, moderation, and governance.
Defines deployment, testing, observability, and staged rollout plans for AI systems.
limitations: It provides engineering guidance, not automatic validation of your production environment.
It cannot confirm live model availability, pricing, or vendor limits without current source checks.
It needs clear data sources, permissions, and success metrics to produce useful designs.
It does not replace legal, compliance, or security review for regulated AI deployments.

use_cases.title: Design a Customer Support Agent
use_cases.description: Plan a tool-using support agent with escalation paths, safety checks, and monitoring.
use_cases.target_user: Product engineers building AI support workflows

use_cases.title: Improve Enterprise Search
use_cases.description: Design a RAG pipeline for internal documents with hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation.

use_cases.title: Prepare an AI Rollout
use_cases.description: Create a rollout plan with cost controls, observability, adversarial tests, and fallback behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an LLM Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new product feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design an LLM feature for [product]. Ask for missing requirements, then propose architecture, data flow, safety controls, and rollout steps.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Retrieval Quality
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a RAG system
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my RAG system goals: [context]. Recommend chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, evaluation metrics, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Design Agent Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production agent workflow for [task]. Include tools, memory, permissions, failure handling, human review, and observability.

prompt_templates.title: Harden Enterprise AI System
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this AI architecture for safety, cost, latency, privacy, and reliability. Provide risks, mitigations, tests, and a staged deployment plan.

output_examples.input: Design a RAG system for an internal policy knowledge base.
output_examples.output: A recommended architecture covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, source citations, evaluation metrics, and operational monitoring.

output_examples.input: Plan a multi-agent workflow for customer service triage.
output_examples.output: A workflow design with agent roles, tool permissions, escalation rules, memory boundaries, safety checks, and failure recovery.

output_examples.input: Review an LLM feature before launch.
output_examples.output: A launch checklist covering privacy, prompt injection defenses, latency, cost controls, observability, adversarial tests, and staged rollout gates.

best_practices: Start with clear success metrics, safety boundaries, and deployment constraints.
Test retrieval quality and model behavior with realistic and adversarial examples.
Add monitoring for cost, latency, errors, safety events, and answer quality.
anti_patterns: Do not send sensitive data to external models without approval and redaction.
Do not rely on a single prompt when workflow controls or validation are required.
Do not launch agents with broad tool access and no human review path.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design and implement LLM apps, RAG systems, AI agents, multimodal workflows, and production AI controls.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation patterns and code structure, but final code still needs project-specific testing and review.

faq.question: Can it help choose a model?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare model choices by task fit, latency, cost, privacy, tool use, and deployment constraints.

faq.question: Is it only for RAG systems?
faq.answer: No. It also covers agents, prompt engineering, multimodal AI, safety, monitoring, APIs, and production operations.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the user workflow, data sources, security limits, expected volume, latency goals, budget, and success metrics.

faq.question: Does it replace security review?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend controls, but regulated or sensitive deployments still need formal security and compliance review.
